note: The stroker later derives export sizes from accumulated border points and contour tags.
The safety obligation is that every border point sequence must have consistent BEGIN/END tags so counts stay valid before export.
Export copies border points into the destination outline using the computed counts; a bad count/tag state can drive an out-of-bounds write.
